recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed; future changes to the SNOMED CT implicit ValueSet wording belong in the THO source that publishes terminology.hl7.org/SNOMEDCT.html.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 issue asking to align the SNOMED CT ECL implicit ValueSet URI with the existing slash-based implicit URI formats by changing ?fhir_vs=ecl:[ecl] to ?fhir_vs=ecl/[ecl].
initial_application: SVN r13310, represented by git commit 9fe99d788004f20048165682a9ff7d64bc23c01d, explicitly referenced GF#14006 and GF#14359 and changed source/snomedct.html from ?fhir_vs=ecl:[ecl] to ?fhir_vs=ecl/[ecl] in the implicit URI list and ECL ValueSet template.
additional_context: FHIR-14006 introduced the ECL implicit ValueSet URI and recorded that r13310 corrected the pre-applied ecl: syntax. Zulip participants supported ecl/ for consistency, and 2018-02-22 Vocab minutes record GF#14006 and related GF#14359 in a 7-0-0 block vote. Later FHIR-35933 removed source/snomedct.html and external terminology detail pages from core, replacing the SNOMED table entry with a THO link while retaining only source/snomedct-usage.html as a local usage report.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current core source contains no ?fhir_vs=ecl: text, source/hierarchy.xml no longer includes source/snomedct.html, source/terminologies-systems.html links to THO's SNOMED CT guidance, and the current THO page documents ?fhir_vs=ecl/[ecl].
